lastEditorialNotes: Two clear patterns emerging: established legal services companies (ClearyX from Cleary Gottlieb, Juro from previous cycle) are launching AI products, and senior Harvey personnel are becoming more vocal about technical direction. The Harvey interview could provide valuable insight into where leading legal AI companies see the technology heading, particularly around autonomous agents and firm-specific models.
